business.description: Aditya Birla Money Limited is a publicly listed, full-service stockbroking company serving nearly one million clients across India. It operates a diversified financial services platform offering equities, derivatives, commodities, mutual funds, IPOs, margin funding, insurance, and lending solutions through a unique 'phygital' model combining digital innovation with personalised relationship management.

outlook.statement: Long-term outlook for India's capital markets remains positive, supported by strong domestic participation, favourable demographics, and increasing financialisation of savings. Near-term challenges include elevated crude oil prices, energy supply concerns, potential weather-related disruptions, and geopolitical uncertainties. Sustained market participation depends on corporate earnings growth, policy reforms, and geopolitical clarity.
IMF projects global GDP growth of 3.1% in CY26 compared to 3.2% in CY25. India's real GDP estimated to have grown by 7.6% in FY26 vs 6.5% in FY25.

The outlook for FY2026-27 is one of cautious optimism. India's ability to maintain a 6.6%+ growth rate while navigating global energy volatility and trade shifts underscores its growing economic maturity. The successful implementation of the UK and EU trade pacts will be the ultimate litmus test for India's ambition to become a global manufacturing and services hub.
World Bank has significantly upgraded its economic outlook for India, raising the projected growth rate from 6.3% to 6.6% for the 2026-27 financial year.
Real GDP growth is projected between 6.6% and 7.2% for FY27.
